summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a press release reporting preliminary assets under management (AUM) for April 2026. The filing is a routine monthly AUM update by Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc., an investment adviser, with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing does not signal any structural change, breakup, or event beyond ordinary business operations. Therefore, this is not a special situation.
